generalCriterionList.description: 1.Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
2.Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

3.It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
4.Tenderers are required to read the bid documents carefully before submission of their bid
5.Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the submitted tender bid shall be liable to be rejected
6.Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time

7.The tenderer shall scan original Workdone certificates Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening

8.The tenderer shall scan original Workdone certificates Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening

9.If the quoted bid amount is less than the tendered amount, the difference in amount shall be remitted in the from of FDR DD Bank Guarantee in the name of Commissioner HDMC Hubli from any of the Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks and shall only be returned/refunded after the Completion of the Defect Liability Period

10.The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW1 The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required in the standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document KW1
11.The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the registered institution or firms with consultants with the Third Party
12.Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
13.Tender application amount shall not be refundable
14.The contractor shall carry out the work preferably in 2 shifts to expedite and complete the work in all respects well before the stipulated time
15.The Department is not responsible for any delay caused in accessing the e-procurement portal
16.The payments for the wok will be made depending upon the availability of funds
17.The Defect liability Period for the work carried out is 365 days (1 year) from DATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
18.Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight age of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
19.The time period for completion of the work is 3 months
20.The Applicable GST paid as per norms
21.List of works for which tenders already submitted and List of existing commitments and ongoing work
